candidate.source: functionally retained candidate supplied to the downstream agent

feature_contract.provenance: independent threat definition and RTL semantics; no downstream implementation or result input
feature_contract.trial_parameter_policy: candidate bits, legal values, seeds, repetitions, and bounded timing sweeps are inferred and recorded before simulation; they do not create additional semantic scenarios
feature_contract.definition: Measure whether changing only a declared untrusted controllable point in paired legal scenarios changes the candidate trace.
feature_contract.execution_model: paired runs differing only in the selected UCP value or legal event timing
feature_contract.calculation: equal-UCP aggregation of valid causal candidate divergences
validity_policy: both runs establish the same legal state
no candidate divergence precedes the intervention

classification.controllable: known causal candidate divergence follows the UCP change
classification.not_controllable: no divergence over the valid scenario/value basis
classification.not_applicable: scenario is outside the candidate's declared scope
classification.invalid: setup, pair equivalence, anchor, or knownness requirement fails

applicability.candidate_scope: candidate with a legal RTL path for this scenario

validity: scenario-specific legal UCP activation and candidate-observation anchor are reached

oracle.success: known post-anchor candidate divergence attributable only to the selected UCP
